sections.heading: New Features
items: Introduced a completely redesigned Now Playing experience
Added an expandable Now Playing player with smooth interactive transitions
Added gesture-based opening and closing between Library and Now Playing
Added real music playback powered by Media3 ExoPlayer
Added queue-aware next and previous track controls
Added real Shuffle and Repeat playback controls
Added dynamic album artwork with cached artwork loading
Added smooth player animations synchronized with the bottom navigation

sections.heading: Now Playing Improvements
items: Improved the Now Playing open and close animations for a smoother and more fluid experience
Improved swipe responsiveness when opening Now Playing from the Library
Improved swipe responsiveness when closing Now Playing
Added smoother Mini Player transitions when opening and closing the full player
Refined the bottom navigation and player controls transition during player expansion
Improved gesture behavior to make the player feel more natural and responsive
Optimized touch interactions throughout the Now Playing screen
Prepared the player gesture system for future swipe-to-change-track functionality

sections.heading: Bug Fixes
items: Fixed an issue where the Now Playing screen could snap back to its previous position when released during a swipe
Fixed overly fast animations when closing the Now Playing screen
Removed unwanted bounce behavior at the end of the closing animation
Fixed Mini Player positioning during Now Playing transitions
Fixed inconsistent animation behavior when opening Now Playing with a short swipe
Fixed unwanted touch feedback when interacting with the Now Playing screen
Improved gesture handling to prevent unexpected transitions during player interactions

sections.heading: Playback
items: Added real local music playback using ExoPlayer
Added queue-aware track navigation
Added functional Shuffle playback
Added functional Repeat playback
Added seeking support for the current track

sections.heading: UI & Visual Improvements
items: Refined the overall Now Playing layout and visual hierarchy
Improved album artwork presentation and transitions
Added smoother animated player expansion and collapse
Improved navigation and control animations for a more consistent experience
Polished player gestures and interactive feedback
